title: Reading: Sue's Birthday Party
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 revision booklet, Reading Part 3 text 4 (with model answers)

scenes.t: Sue had a birthday party on Sunday. There were many of her friends there.
There were fun games to play at Sue's party: ring games, balloon popping, pin the tail on the donkey, and lots more.
There was lots of food too: hotdogs, popcorn, cotton candy, and more.
There were clowns, horseback riding, and a bounce castle.
All the children at the party had fun and they all got a party bag to take home.

items.q: What kind of party did Sue have?
Name one game at Sue's party.
Name one food at Sue's party.
What did the children leave with?
Other than food and games, what else was at the party?
o: Clowns, horseback riding, and a bounce castle
